_about: Numbers behind docs/project/performance.md and the charts from scripts/make_perf_charts.py. Raw logs are in this directory; see benchmarks/README.md for how they were produced.

training_vs_lightning.hardware: GCP n1-standard-8 + 1x Tesla T4 (driver 580.178.04), Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.12, torch 2.15.0+cu132, Lightning 2.6.6
training_vs_lightning.method: benchmarks/lightning_comparison: 100 and 600 steps, 3 runs each in fresh processes, one at a time; ms/step = (median 600 - median 100) / 500; start-up = median 100-step wall - 100 x step

distributed_startup.method: benchmarks/distributed_startup.py and benchmarks/multi_machine.py: trivial job (import torch, init_process_group, all_reduce/barrier), 2 nodes x 2 processes, gloo; median of runs
distributed_startup.unit: s, submit to client sees the result

rows.setup: Two GCP VMs over the network

http.method: benchmarks/http_requests.py (TLS, loopback) and benchmarks/multi_machine.py scale section

multi_machine.hardware: GCP europe-west1-b: n1-standard-8 + T4 (server, workers 't4' 1 slot and 't4-cpu' 6 slots) and e2-standard-8 (worker 'cpu8', 8 slots)
